title: Apply pending changes
description: Applies current pending changes to the FieldWorks project as one unit of work; the optional --message must be one line of at most 128 characters. Text summarizes counts and points to the full effects file; --effects prints it, --json keeps the full effects array, and a current Dry Run can waive Correctness for a judgment-only Proposal while mixed changes still need normal Readiness evidence. Autonomous mode requires a project-declared gate and the newest Trial's green verdict for its required words, current policy and live project state.
